      "snippet": "You’re right — the baseline had a bunch of “that doesn’t make sense” problems. I found the main ones and fixed them in a cleaned-up v1.1 build (still simple, but now logically consistent and classroom-usable).
What didn’t make sense (and what I fixed)

Type-It never changed the word

Baseline: you typed the same prompt forever.

Fix: Next button + Enter-to-check + new word loads.

Choose-the-Correct distractors were nonsense

Baseline: it always tried replace(vowel,"a") / replace(vowel,"e"), whi"
